title: Guided lab: trace a request using DevTools
description: Bring the entire module together by building a local diagnostic server, tracing requests in DevTools, and correlating browser responses with server logs.
objectives: Trace document and API requests using the Network panel
Correlate a response to server logs with a request identifier
Separate application HTTP failures from network failures
Collect a reproducible debugging report without leaking credentials
rubric: I used DevTools to inspect a success and an HTTP 404.
I matched both request IDs to their server-side diagnostic logs.
I wrote a reproducible report and passed the trace lab test.
